The '''jeweled belt''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' in the possession of [[Nynaeve al'Meara]].{{ref/book|9|33}} It was recovered from the [[Kin's Storeroom]] in the [[Rahad]] district of [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref/book|8|4}}

==Appearance==
The belt is made of gold and is covered in very fine rubies.

==Use==
The ''ter'angreal'' is a [[well]], allowing the user to fill it with extra ''saidar'' to use even when cut off from the source.
